summary.text: Jonah Wheeler is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 33 who assumed office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as a community organizer with the Rights & Democracy Institute.

paragraphs.text: Jonah Wheeler's career experience includes working as a community organizer with the Rights & Democracy Institute, and Ballotpedia says he has served on a local zoning board.
Wheeler assumed office in the New Hampshire House on December 7, 2022.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and shares the two-seat Hillsborough 33 ballot with fellow incumbent Peter Leishman.
